ItemID: unavailable; Title: In-A-Gadda-Da-Vida; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: Its psychedelic rock sound connects with my interest in Hendrix, but I would stick with my Clapton picks this time.
ItemID: unavailable; Title: Django and Jimmie; ALIGN: yes; RATING: NA; REASON: The country sound could suit my interest in Blown Away, but it is not what I would choose today.
